Counsel for Petitioner :- Manish Kumar Pandey Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vivek Kumar Birla,J.
Hon'ble Arun Kumar Singh Deshwal,J.
1. Heard Shri Manish Kumar Pandey, learned counsel for the petitioners and Shri Pradeep Kumar Jaiswal, learned A.G.A. for the State respondents.

2. The present writ petition has been preferred with the prayer to quash the impugned First Information Report dated 09.07.2024 registered as Case Crime No. 201 of 2024, under Sections Shakeel Ahmad And 6 Others vs State Of Up And 3 Others on 13 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/7222752/
1 498A, 323, 354 IpC and Section 3/4 Muslim Women (Protection of Rights on Marriage) Act, 2019,
Police Station Nagina, District Bijnor and for a direction to the respondents not to arrest the petitioners in pursuance of impugned First Information Report.

entities.text: Sections Shakeel Ahmad And 6 Others vs State Of Up And 3 Others on 13 August
entities.label: PROVISION

entities.text: Muslim Women (Protection of Rights on Marriage) Act, 2019
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 3. Although prayer for quashing of FIR has been made but without insisting on the same only submission is that all alleged offences are punishable with imprisonment upto seven years, therefore the police authorities are bound to follow the procedure laid down under Section 41-A Cr.P.C.
The petitioners have been wrongly implicated and could not be arrested.

Reliance has been placed on the judgement of Apex Court in Arnesh Kumar Vs. State of Bihar, (2014) 8 SCC 273 and Social Action Forum for Manav Adhikar Vs. Union of India, Ministry of Law and Justice and others in Writ Petition (Civil) No. 73 of 2015 with Criminal Appeal No. 1265 of 2017, Writ Petition (Criminal) No.
156 of 2017, Satendra Kumar Antil vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and Another, (2022) 10 SCC 51 and co-ordinate Division Bench of this Court in Vimal Kumar & 3 others Vs. State of U.P. & 3 others in 2021 (2) ACR 1147.
4.

sentences.text:
We have gone through the impugned first information report and without interfering in the same,
we are of the opinion that the guidelines framed by the Apex Court in the above noted judgement are equally applicable to the facts of the instant case.
5. Accordingly, the instant petition also stands disposed of in terms of the judgements as noted above.
